findings.evidence: Lines 107–140 make up most of the theorem body; the result is used only in the `univ` goal of `VectorMeasure.ext_of_generateFrom` at line 145.
findings.fix: Extract it as a lemma, e.g. `Integrable.integral_eq_zero_of_forall_predictableRectangle`, and cite it in the main proof; or at least add a comment stating the proof structure.
findings.issue: `htotal` inside `Integrable.ae_eq_zero_of_forall_predictableRectangle` is a ~30-line inline argument (monotone cover `U n`, `tendsto_setIntegral_of_monotone`, `setIntegral_union`). No comment explains that it exists only to supply the `univ` side condition of `VectorMeasure.ext_of_generateFrom`.

findings.fix: Prove it directly: show the underlying indicator function is a.e. zero (it is supported on a null set) and close with `Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero` or an `indicatorConstLp`/`toLp` congruence. Alternatively, factor it as a small named lemma.
findings.issue: `hz` shows an indicator of a null set is zero in Lp by going through the norm (`norm_eq_zero`, `norm_indicatorConstLp`) and an unscoped `simp [Measure.real, hnull]` that unfolds `Measure.real`. This is roundabout and fragile.

summary: The proofs are mostly robust, but the separation theorem has an uncommented ~30-line total-integral block that should be its own lemma. Two covering arguments re-derive an existing Mathlib lemma by hand.
